title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM
The BOR object types MOVEINDOC and MOVEOUTDOC have the following methods that you can use to create your own
workflows:

e GETDOCSBILLINGFICA (determine the documents to reverse)

e REVERSEDOCSBILLINGFICA (reverse the documents)

e REVERSELOGDISPLAY (display the reversal log)

Activities
Search parameters
Use the search parameters for move-in or move-out to create or process a move-in or move-out separately.

If you want to create a move-in/out for a business partner, you can use the move-out search parameters to select the installations
and determine the business partner. You do not have to determine the business partner on the move-in page.

If you want to create a move-in/out for a premise, you can use the move-out search parameters to search for the installations for
both the move-in and move-out. You do not have to determine the premise on the move-in page.

Insert Contract

Use

You use this function to allocate contracts in order to cover the vacant status periods of one or more installations.

This functions affects installations that are vacant over a given period. No contract is allocated to the installation over the vacant
status period; however, the installation has a contract that begins at the end of the vacant status period. The function entails a
move-in and move-out. Note that the move-in of the second contract (to be allocated at the end of the vacant status period) does
not have to be reversed.

If the second contract has already been invoiced then these bills are automatically reversed for adjustment. If the installation is
billed again, the system creates a redundant bill for the contract. This bill is automatically suppressed. This ensures that the

customer moving in to the installation only receives one bill.

The Insert Move-In/Out action has been enhanced to include the Remove Contract function. If the contract to be removed, or a
subsequent contract has already been invoiced then you must perform a full reversal, or bill the affected period. The Remove
Contract function contains the full reversal functionality; however restrictions apply.

Integration

The Insert Contract function is integrated in the move-in/out transaction (EC60).

Prerequisites

The adjustment reversal functionality contained in this function requires all documents to be invoiced. Documents that have been
billed but not invoiced cannot be adjusted for reversal. You cannot debug this function since debugging causes data
